archetype: CSP where default-src governs styles and scripts together
notes: The subtlest branch of the policy edit, and the one most likely to be got wrong. No style directive exists, so default-src governs the stylesheet — but it governs the script channel too, and appending a nonce to it would authorise a nonced <script> as well. HEO must add an explicit style-src-elem carrying default-src's own sources plus the nonce, and leave default-src untouched. C2 checks that no other directive gained a token.
